selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: Who are the people described in this passage as giving strong support to the Prophet’s truthfulness?
questions.answer: Large numbers of sincere and careful scholars and faithful wise people who reached the highest level of learning through his teachings.

questions.question: What is striking about their learning in relation to the Prophet’s personal background?
questions.answer: They gained very high knowledge through the teachings of someone who himself was not formally taught in the usual way.

questions.question: Besides teaching sacred truths, what two other achievements are attributed to him in the passage?
questions.answer: He is presented as bringing forth lofty branches of knowledge and uncovering God-given understanding.

questions.question: What central belief do these scholars and sages strongly confirm?
questions.answer: They firmly confirm the oneness of Allah.

questions.question: According to the passage, how is that belief connected to the Prophet’s mission?
questions.answer: It is described as the basic foundation of his mission.

questions.question: In addition to affirming Divine unity, what else do they testify to?
questions.answer: They testify that he was truthful and that what he said was true.

questions.question: How united are they said to be in this testimony?
questions.answer: They are presented as being in full agreement.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the strength of the evidence they use?
questions.answer: It says they rely on the strongest proofs.

questions.question: What comparison is used to show how clear this proof is?
questions.answer: It is compared to something as obvious as daylight.

questions.question: How does the passage present the Risale-i Nur in relation to this evidence?
questions.answer: It presents the hundred-part Risale-i Nur as one proof among the proofs of his truthfulness.

questions.question: What kind of people are highlighted at the beginning of the passage?
questions.answer: Purified, sincere, precise scholars and trustworthy sages.

questions.question: How did these people reach the highest rank of learning?
questions.answer: They reached it through the teaching and training contained in the sacred truths brought by the Prophet.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention that he was unlettered?
questions.answer: To show the remarkable nature of the knowledge and instruction connected to him.

questions.question: What kinds of knowledge are connected to him in the passage?
questions.answer: Elevated sciences and Divine forms of knowledge.

questions.question: What is the first major thing these scholars and sages prove together?
questions.answer: The oneness of Allah.

questions.question: What is the second major thing they bear witness to together?
questions.answer: The truthfulness of the Prophet as a supreme teacher and great guide, and the truth of his words.

questions.question: Does the passage treat their witness as weak opinion, personal admiration, or solid evidence?
questions.answer: Solid evidence.

questions.question: What wording shows the passage sees their agreement as especially strong?
questions.answer: It says they are unanimous and supported by the strongest proofs.

questions.question: What role does the Risale-i Nur play in the final sentence of the passage?
questions.answer: It is presented as a further proof of the Prophet’s truthfulness.

questions.question: What does the mention of the hundred parts of Risale-i Nur add to the argument?
questions.answer: It adds that this work also serves as a proof supporting his truthfulness.

questions.question: According to the passage, what qualities mark the scholars and sages being discussed?
questions.answer: They are spiritually refined, honest, careful, faithful, and highly learned.

questions.question: What produced their growth into top-level scholars, according to the passage?
questions.answer: The teachings and instruction found in the sacred truths brought by the Prophet.

questions.question: What tension or contrast appears in the description of the Prophet?
questions.answer: Even though he was unlettered, he is linked with profound teaching, major sciences, and God-given knowledge.

questions.question: What does the passage say he brought or uncovered?
questions.answer: It says he introduced exalted sciences and discovered Divine knowledge.
